traits.name: Slow
traits.text: A zombie is permanently slowed 1 and can't use reactions.

traits.name: Jaws
traits.text: ⬻ (attack); Requirements The zombie has a creature grabbed or restrained. Effect The zombie makes a jaws unarmed melee Strike against the grabbed or restrained creature with an attack modifier of +9 that deals 1d12+4 (1d12+4) piercing damage. A creature damaged by the jaws is exposed to zombie rot.
